headline: Leantime full audit and artifact cleanup
description:
Objective

Perform a full audit of Leantime and repository task artifacts, clean up stale or misleading status records, create follow-up todos for unresolved items, and establish one repository-level task index outside per-task AI folders.

Scope

  • Inventory tasks, milestones, wiki, goals, ideas, blueprints, retrospectives
  • Compare Leantime state with .copilot/tasks artifacts
  • Patch clearly stale task and milestone statuses when repository evidence is sufficient
  • Create follow-up todos for unresolved cleanup items
  • Create or update a central repository task index
  • Document how these artifact families should be managed going forward

Acceptance Criteria

  • Full Leantime inventory captured
  • Status drift patched where evidence is sufficient
  • Every unresolved audit finding has a Leantime todo
  • Repository-level task index exists or is updated
  • Final guidance explains retention and usage of tasks, milestones, ideas, blueprints, retrospectives, goals, and wiki

Task Workspace

.copilot/tasks/2026-04-25-leantime-full-audit/
